This approach aims to avoid unnecessary risk of testicular or vasal injury associated with an inguinal exploration. While there are individual cases where an inguinal approach may be necessary, the overall trend suggests that treating a contralateral hydrocele in neonatal testicular torsion should be approached as "less" with caution, especially for patients who do not have contralateral hydrocele.
